fixture_reference.name: coding-loop-eval-v1
fixture_reference.description: Reuse the disposable Rust project recipe already owned by eval_coding_loop.sh; do not create a second runtime eval harness.
fixture_reference.generic_description: Reuse only the deterministic fixture recipes for fresh disposable ordinary-directory Projects. The scripted MCP driver is runtime acceptance, not a real ChatGPT sample. Prepare and fingerprint identical inputs before each real Direct/Host Code Mode/Code Mode run; record the exact harness Git base and independent correctness evidence with the existing reporter and bounded annotation. Case-specific external writes and pipe release are fixture coordination, not a model runtime or new report schema. Use only admitted tools; keep Job tools outside nested Code Mode.

cases.title: Read-only review
cases.prompt: Perform a read-only review. Inspect git status, read src/tool_runtime/window_activity.rs and docs/architecture/tool-composition-research.md, search for project_window_loop_timings references, inspect the current git diff, and report concrete findings. Do not modify files and do not run mutation tools.

validation.expectation: No code validation is required; final workspace must remain unchanged.

cases.title: Focused structured edit plus validation
cases.prompt: In the disposable coding-loop eval Rust project, change greeting() from "hello" to "hello baseline" without changing topic(). Inspect the resulting diff, run cargo check successfully, and report the final changed file and validation result.

cases.title: Failed validation recovery
cases.prompt: Use test-first recovery in the disposable coding-loop eval Rust project. First add a unit test named greeting_matches_recovery_target asserting greeting() == "hello recovered" and run cargo test while greeting() still returns "hello"; inspect the expected failing diagnostic. Then change greeting() to "hello recovered", rerun cargo test successfully, inspect the final diff, and report both the observed failing validation and the successful rerun.

cases.title: Long validation and same-execution Job handoff
cases.prompt: Do not modify files. Start cargo test --lib with sync_wait_secs=1 and a sufficient total timeout. If it hands off, preserve that exact Job identity; while it runs, independently inspect the timing terminology in docs/architecture/tool-composition-research.md, then observe the same Job to terminal completion. Do not redispatch cargo test. If the validation finishes synchronously before handoff, report that this run does not satisfy the handoff case instead of fabricating one.

cases.title: Independent read-only observations
cases.prompt: Perform a read-only readiness check for the Agent Loop baseline. Report whether the workspace is clean, whether the current worktree diff contains changes, where CODE_MODE_TOOLS is defined, and the documented meaning of observed_span_ms. Inspect the relevant repository sources and report only those facts. Do not modify files.

validation.expectation: No code validation is required; final workspace must remain unchanged.

required_observations: targeted read of defining code or protocol text

cases.prompt: Inspect docs/task-notes.md in the disposable coding-loop eval project. That optional note may be absent; if the read reports it missing, treat that as the expected business result and continue by reading README.md. Report the README title and the stable phrase describing why the project exists. Do not modify files.

Return exactly three concise facts: the rule for independent versus adaptive observations, what observed_span_ms does not mean, and the authorization rule for deploy/restart. Do not quote long passages and do not modify files.

required_final_facts: observed_span_ms is not task wall time

cases.prompt: In the prepared ordinary-directory Project, organize input/note.txt, pixel.png, document.pdf and bytes.bin into sorted/. Preserve all sources and the existing sorted/note.txt; copy the incoming note to sorted/note-2.txt. Use artifact transfer for binaries. Check final paths, file counts, binary signatures and SHA-256 equality with the inputs; report the observed conflict policy and outputs. Do not overwrite the conflict.

fixture.text: input/note.txt = original note followed by LF; sorted/note.txt = keep conflict followed by LF; deterministic binaries from binary_fixtures()
fixture.environment: Disposable loopback Runner Project; fixed GenericSmoke locale/timezone/Python environment; record source hashes before the timed run.

required_assertions: note-2.txt and three binary copies match original SHA-256
valid PNG 1x1, PDF structure and 1024 binary bytes

validation.expectation: Independent fixture-side enumeration and SHA-256 checks of every original/copy and preserved conflict; independently parse PNG/PDF structures. Neither script stdout nor metadata alone passes this case.

cases.title: Inspect a nonzero command and repair it
cases.prompt: In this disposable Project run the prepared pressure command: print pressure-0 through pressure-2499, print GENERIC_ACCEPTANCE_UNIQUE_SENTINEL_9d06, print expected failure to stderr, and exit 7. Inspect the observed exit code and diagnostic. Repair only the intentional failure by removing the stderr/exit lines, rerun once, and confirm exit 0 and the sentinel. Report both outcomes; never count the expected failure as a contract repair turn.

fixture.command: Python script with exactly the sequence described in the prompt
fixture.environment: Fixed Python/locale/timezone; no real secrets or external endpoints; use existing structured command or run_script tools.

required_assertions: unique stdout sentinel retained in actual MCP response

validation.expectation: Independent inspection of exit statuses and retained logs from the same executions; count sentinel occurrences in actual bounded MCP envelopes without recording credential headers.

cases.title: Pending Job with independent work and one join
cases.prompt: Start exactly one interactive Python process that reads stdin to EOF and then prints controlled-job-complete. It must return a pending Job; retain its identity/continuation. While it waits, write independent.txt with independent work completed. Close stdin on the original Job through job_write_input, then perform one bounded wait_for_job_readiness join and observe that same Job to terminal exit 0. Do not redispatch, immediately poll while independent work remains, or repeat waits. If there is no genuine pending handoff, mark the case unsatisfied.

fixture.environment: Disposable Runner; interactive pipe only, no PTY; 30-second child timeout and one 30-second readiness wait. EOF is the deterministic release, not timing sleeps.

required_assertions: independent file exists before releasing input

validation.expectation: Independent fixture-side check of independent.txt bytes and tool/audit order, one dispatch, one wait and identical Job identity through release/observation; script claims alone cannot establish order.

cases.title: Reject stale edit and preserve external writer change
cases.prompt: Read stale.txt and retain read_revision. After that first read, the fixture operator directly appends EXTERNAL_WRITER_SENTINEL_c741 followed by LF to the file and confirms the write before you proceed. Attempt exactly one edit_project_files replacement task value: before to task value: after using the original expected_read_revision; it must fail as stale_file_revision without any byte change. Independently verify those unchanged bytes, perform a fresh read_files call, reconsider the current content, and retry the intended replacement using the new revision. Verify the final file contains the task change and the exact external sentinel line. Do not manufacture the external write through a model tool, omit the revision fence or replay the stale write. If fixture coordination did not happen, mark this case unsatisfied.

fixture.coordination: Fixture operator waits for first read, directly writes appended bytes outside tool caches, captures SHA-256, signals completion before stale edit, and checks disk immediately after rejection and recovery. The deterministic acceptance driver owns this write itself; real ChatGPT replay needs the same operator boundary.
fixture.environment: Same disposable Project, content and source fingerprint for all variants; supported in baseline and upgraded.

required_assertions: old revision edit returns success=false/error_kind stale_file_revision/state_changed=false
rejected edit leaves exact external bytes unchanged
fresh read returns a different revision before next edit

final bytes task value: after
EXTERNAL_WRITER_SENTINEL_c741

validation.expectation: Independent fixture-side exact byte/SHA-256 checks before external write, after rejection and after recovery; verify call order and revisions separately from tool success flags.

cases.title: Missing declared output blocks closeout
cases.prompt: In the disposable Project, independently confirm missing-result.csv does not exist. Finish the task while declaring outputs=[missing-result.csv]. Inspect task_outputs and task_outcome: the file must remain unverified and the task must remain blocked/fail. Report this expected negative result as a successfully exercised closeout guard, not a successful user deliverable. Do not create the file or silently omit the declared output. If the deployed contract does not support outputs, mark this upgrade-only case unsupported rather than fabricating a receipt.

fixture.environment: Upgrade profile only; fresh task Session in disposable ordinary-directory Project; use existing canonical finish tool and admitted gateway when needed.

required_assertions: task_outcome status fail and blocking true
absence not represented as verified output

validation.expectation: Independent fixture-side filesystem absence check and structured receipt/outcome inspection; baseline is unsupported, not a pass or comparable upgrade sample.
